card.name: Verbs before monitoring or action instructions
card.fires_on: Small words in warning sections that come right before an instruction: "be" after "should" or "has", "calling" after "importance of", and a comma after "is suspected".

modes.label: "be" after should/has
modes.description: The word "be" after "should" or "has", just before a verb such as monitored or established.
modes.example: Hepatic function should<< be>> monitored closely, with both clinical and laboratory

modes.label: Comma after "is suspected"
modes.description: The comma that follows "is suspected", just before the instruction to stop or withhold the drug.
modes.example: If ILD/pneumonitis is suspected<<,>> withhold DATROWAY and initiate cortic

modes.label: "calling" before 911
modes.description: The word "calling" in the advice to educate patients and caregivers about emergency help.
modes.example: emphasize the importance of<< calling>> 911 or getting emergency medical

card.writes: No clear output effect; the promoted tokens look unrelated to the text and the suppressed ones are mostly analysis-type words.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words in warnings, right before the label says what to do next.
